Hi Emma —

Thanks again for a productive discovery this morning. Quick recap and proposed next step: we want to schedule a focused engineering runthrough with our ML + infra leads to cover architecture fit, sample workloads, and a concrete runbook for a pilot. Target duration: 60–90 minutes (we recommend 75).

Goals for the session (high level):
- Walk through your inference workload and peak patterns
- Validate model/format and any sample data needs
- Discuss routing/fallback and cost/latency targets
- Draft a short runbook: who owns what, rollout steps, and fallbacks

Please confirm who from your side should attend (ML lead, infra, SRE/product owner are typical) and which of these windows works for you next week:
- Tue, Dec 1 — 14:00–15:15 EST (75m)
- Wed, Dec 2 — 10:00–11:15 EST (75m)
- Thu, Dec 3 — 08:30–09:45 PST (75m)

If none of those work, share two alternatives and your timezone and we will lock a slot. I attached a short post-discovery summary and a draft agenda for the runthrough.

Also helpful before the session: a sample request/response (anonymized) or a short description of token lengths and concurrency targets. If you want, we can stand up a short test harness during the call.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning calendars.

Best,
Kimberly Park
